entities.summary: Dia Frampton is an American musician, singer and songwriter. Frampton is the lead singer of the band Meg & Dia, was the runner-up in the inaugural season of The Voice, and is also known for her presence and collaborations in the EDM world, having worked with DJs such as Illenium and Kaskade among many others.
